text: Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2023 earnings call.

speaker_name: I'm the Chief Executive Officer of META.
text: We delivered record revenue of $20.6 billion this quarter, representing 9% year-over-year growth.

speaker_name: I'm the Chief Executive Officer of META.
text: Revenue guidance of $20.6 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.

speaker_name: I'm the Chief Executive Officer of META.
text: I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.

speaker_name: I'm the Chief Executive Officer of META.
text: Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2023.

speaker_name: I'm the Chief Executive Officer of META.
text: Our gross margin expanded by 192 basis points to 40.3%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.

speaker_name: I'm the Chief Executive Officer of META.
text: Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We generated $16.5 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 192 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
